author: targum-pseudo-jonathan

original.text: וַחֲזָא יְיָ יַת נְהוֹרָא אֲרוּם טַב וְאַפְרֵישׁ יְיָ בֵּין נְהוֹרָא וּבֵין חֲשׁוֹכָא

english.text: And the Lord beheld the light, that it was good; and the Lord divided between the light and the darkness.

notes: The expansive targum, and on this verse it expands nothing: its Gen 1:4 is Onkelos letter for letter. One verse later it is at work again — the light was made so that the inhabitants of the world might labour by it, the darkness so that the creatures might rest in it — which is Remigius' reason for the division, arrived at in Aramaic. That the expansion attaches to the naming in v. 5 and not to the dividing in v. 4 is itself evidence about where the rabbinic bench thought the difficulty lay.
